The Milagrow Duster Lux  Vacuum Cleaner Is A Compact & Premium Portable Vacuum With Mammoth 14000 Pa Suction And A 6000 MAh Battery. Its Vibrant & Luxurious Design Is Complemented By A HEPA-13 Filter For Effective Dust And Allergen Removal. It Comes With Four Versatile Accessories Making It Perfect For Cleaning Tricky And Hard To Reach Car, Home, Kitchen And Office Spaces.

About this product

  1. Suction Power- The Milagrow Duster Lux Delivers A Powerful 14000Pa Suction Ensuring Top-notch Cleaning Anytime Anywhere 24×7.
  2. Battery Power- With A 6000 MAh Li-Ion Battery Delivering 24-34 Minutes Runtime, It Allows For Uninterrupted Cleaning Sessions
  3. Versatile Cleaning Attachment – You Can Easily Clean Your Car, Home Or Office Without Needing To Frequent Recharges, Crevice Nozzle With Brush Adapts To Various Surfaces.
  4. Charging Time- 3 Hours, Use Your Existing Mobile Charger With The C Type USB Cable.
  5. HEPA-13 Filter- The HEPA-13 Filter Effectively Filters Minutest Dust Of Up To 0.05 Micron, The Stainless Steel Cover Protects The HEPA Filter, Giving It A Longer Life, Thereby Extending The Vacuum’s Lifespan.
  6. Powerful Suction & Quiet Operation – The Brushless Motor Delivers An Impressive 14000 Pa Suction Power From Compact Vacuum. Thanks To Its Efficient Design, This Cordless Handheld Vacuum Produces Just 40 DB Noise, Preventing Disturbances To Your Family And Pets.
  7. Versatile Cleaning – The Milagrow Duster Lux Vacuum Cleaner Is Perfect For Cleaning Your Home, Office, Or Car. It Effortlessly Picks Up Dust, Pet Hair, Sand, Food Crumbs, And Debris From Cushions, Sofas, Car Interiors And More. A Must-have Handy Product For Every Home And Car!
  8. Care For Gadgets With Milagrow Duster Lux – Regularly Use Duster Lux Vacuum Cleaner To Gently Remove Fine Dust And Dirt From Your Expensive Gadgets, Ensuring Their Longevity And Optimal Performance.
